audience: B2–C1 English/German learners who understand more language than they can reliably reuse; teachers, researchers and agents are adjacent integration audiences.
useful_action: Bring a real sentence to Pattern Lens, inspect one reviewed Frame, produce a new example, and continue to a reviewed learning object.

editorial_opportunity.question: Does a learner who brings a real sentence complete the reviewed Lens loop: match → own example → structural check → reviewed continuation?
editorial_opportunity.proof_required: Use current engineering regressions for retrieval correctness and independent participant evidence for usefulness or repeat pull. Do not reinterpret a returned match or completed check as learning efficacy.
editorial_opportunity.success_observation: Measure Useful Reuse Sessions and repeat pull separately from search impressions, indexing, independent AI citations and language-learning outcomes.

constraints: No fabricated first-hand results, reviews, users, credentials or endorsements.
Profile validity does not prove indexing, recommendations or rank.
Engineering retrieval benchmarks do not prove learner usefulness, retention or language-learning efficacy.
Preserve product privacy and publication boundaries.
